metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.3 · 1977 · The Hills Have Eyes
metas.description: On the way to California, a family has the misfortune to have their car break down in an area closed to the public, and inhabited by violent savages ready to attack.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 3.8 · 1984 · The Hills Have Eyes Part II
metas.description: A group of bikers, heading to a race, become stranded in the desert and find themselves fighting off a family of inbred cannibals who live off the land.
